name: ottermind

plugins.name: sqlx
plugins.description: List saved OtterMind SQLX datasources, test connections, run SQL against MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, GreatSQL, OceanBase, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, openGauss, Oracle, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Trino, StarRocks, Apache Doris, TDengine, Dameng and KingbaseES, run Redis commands and MongoDB command documents, and open local result pages. Credentials stay in the SQLX data directory.

description: OtterMind plugins for Claude Code. Currently ships SQLX for MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, GreatSQL, OceanBase, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, openGauss, Oracle, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Trino, StarRocks, Apache Doris, TDengine, Dameng, KingbaseES, Redis and MongoDB.
